description: This file defines the JunitSuiteWrapper class, which is used to assemble and manage a collection of test suites and test cases within a JUnit testing framework for the OFBiz project. It reads test suite configurations from XML documents, creates models of these test suites, and provides methods to retrieve and populate test cases for execution.

classes.name: JunitSuiteWrapper
classes.description: A helper class to load, assemble, and manage test suites and test cases for JUnit testing within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: JunitSuiteWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test suite models by reading configurations for a specified component and suite.

methods.name: populateTestSuite
methods.description: Deprecated method that adds all test cases from the models into a given TestSuite object.

methods.name: getModelTestSuites
methods.description: Returns the list of ModelTestSuite objects representing the configured test suites.

methods.name: getAllTestList
methods.description: Returns a flattened list of all Test instances from all test suites.
